Description: Checks that voice-call MFA is not active.
Risk: Voice-call MFA inherits PSTN risks and can be abused through telephony attacks.

Code.Other:
1. In the Okta Admin Console, go to Security > Authenticators or Security > Multifactor.
2. Verify users have an alternative authenticator available.
3. Remove voice call from enrollment and sign-in policies.
4. Deactivate the voice-call factor or phone voice method.
5. Review exceptions for accessibility or break-glass use and document compensating controls.

Recommendation.Text: Disable voice-call MFA and migrate users to stronger authenticators.

Notes: Requires the Okta read scopes documented for the referenced management APIs.
